figs.name: logic-gates-and-gate-from-three-nor-gates-diagram
figs.alt: logic gates diagram showing an AND gate built from three NOR gates
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how three NOR gates make an AND gate: two NOR gates invert A and B, and the third NORs them to give A·B.
figs.after_h2: XAND Gate Meaning and How to Make AND Using NOR Gates

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">

<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Making an AND Gate From Three NOR Gates</text>
<path d="M220 118 Q246 150 220 182 Q272 182 304 150 Q272 118 220 118 Z" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="311" cy="150" r="7" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2.5"/>

<path d="M470 213 Q496 245 470 277 Q522 277 554 245 Q522 213 470 213 Z" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="561" cy="245" r="7" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="510" y="203" font-size="17" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">NOR 3</text>
<text x="50" y="157" font-size="22" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">A</text>
<line x1="70" y1="150" x2="150" y2="150" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="150" cy="150" r="5" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<polyline points="150,150 150,135 230,135" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<polyline points="150,150 150,165 230,165" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="50" y="347" font-size="22" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">B</text>
<line x1="70" y1="340" x2="150" y2="340" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="150" cy="340" r="5" fill="#1a2b4a"/>

<polyline points="318,150 400,150 400,230 480,230" fill="none" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="350" y="140" font-size="20" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">A'</text>
<polyline points="318,340 400,340 400,260 480,260" fill="none" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="3"/>

figs.name: logic-gates-identify-from-truth-table-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to identify AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR or XNOR from a truth table
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a decision flow that names a gate from its truth table by checking when the output is 1 or 0.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to identify a logic gate from its truth table</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Identify the Gate From Its Truth Table</text>
<rect x="200" y="50" width="260" height="42" rx="10" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="330.0" y="77.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Read the truth table</text>
<line x1="330" y1="92" x2="330" y2="104" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="330,105.0 560.0,134 330,163.0 100.0,134" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="330" y="139.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">One input only?</text>
<line x1="560" y1="134" x2="612" y2="134" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="586" y="126" font-size="17" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="614" y="112" width="166" height="44" rx="10" fill="#4f46e5" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="697.0" y="140.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">NOT: Ā</text>
<line x1="330" y1="163" x2="330" y2="177" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="345" y="176" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="330,177.0 560.0,206 330,235.0 100.0,206" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="330" y="211.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Out 1 only when inputs differ?</text>
<line x1="560" y1="206" x2="612" y2="206" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="586" y="198" font-size="17" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="614" y="184" width="166" height="44" rx="10" fill="#312e81" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="697.0" y="212.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">XOR</text>
<line x1="330" y1="235" x2="330" y2="249" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="345" y="248" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="330,249.0 560.0,278 330,307.0 100.0,278" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="330" y="283.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Out 1 only when inputs match?</text>
<line x1="560" y1="278" x2="612" y2="278" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="586" y="270" font-size="17" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="614" y="256" width="166" height="44" rx="10" fill="#4f46e5" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="697.0" y="284.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">XNOR</text>
<line x1="330" y1="307" x2="330" y2="321" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="345" y="320" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="330,321.0 560.0,350 330,379.0 100.0,350" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="330" y="355.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Out 1 only when all inputs are 1?</text>
<line x1="560" y1="350" x2="612" y2="350" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="586" y="342" font-size="17" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="614" y="328" width="166" height="44" rx="10" fill="#312e81" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="697.0" y="356.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">AND: A·B</text>
<line x1="330" y1="379" x2="330" y2="393" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="345" y="392" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="330,393.0 560.0,422 330,451.0 100.0,422" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="330" y="427.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Out 0 only when all inputs are 1?</text>
<line x1="560" y1="422" x2="612" y2="422" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="586" y="414" font-size="17" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="614" y="400" width="166" height="44" rx="10" fill="#4f46e5" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="697.0" y="428.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">NAND</text>
<line x1="330" y1="451" x2="330" y2="465" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="345" y="464" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="330,465.0 560.0,494 330,523.0 100.0,494" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="330" y="499.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Out 1 only when all inputs are 0?</text>
<line x1="560" y1="494" x2="612" y2="494" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="586" y="486" font-size="17" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="614" y="472" width="166" height="44" rx="10" fill="#312e81" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="697.0" y="500.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">NOR</text>
<line x1="330" y1="523" x2="330" y2="538" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="220" y="538" width="220" height="44" rx="10" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="330.0" y="566.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Otherwise: OR</text>
<text x="615" y="565" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">NAND and NOR</text>
<text x="615" y="588" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">are universal</text>
</svg>
